setup.gateway.title: 3. Connect a gateway
setup.gateway.desc: A gateway is a separate process that carries messages between a chat service (Discord, Nostr, the web, a terminal, Bluesky) and the core. It connects to the core over the gate socket. Nothing is registered in the core beforehand.
setup.gateway.repos: Gateways live in their own repositories:
